name: ShellyLanMan
description: Discover, monitor and manage Shelly devices on your local network. ShellyLanMan provides live device status, configuration, backups, firmware management, charts and an MCP interface.

notes.text: UI authentication is off by default. Set a password in Settings → Security before allowing access beyond a trusted LAN.
mDNS discovery requires multicast traffic between the LXC and Shelly devices. Use the same VLAN initially, or configure an mDNS reflector.
